messages:
emma (finance): Hey team — noticed an invoice generation issue for AcmeCorp (acct: ACME-42). Invoice 2026-03-INV-890 shows compute=0 but customer was charged for compute elsewhere. Total also off by -$3,200. Can someone triage?

mike (billing-eng): Oof. Can you paste the invoice JSON or PDF id?

emma (finance): invoice_id: 2026-03-INV-890, pdf link: https://billing.internal/2026-03-INV-890.pdf 

emma (finance): quick snippet from the generated lines: 
```
[
  {"code":"COMPUTE","desc":"GPU hours","quantity":120,"unit_price":25.0,"line_total":0.0},
  {"code":"PROMO_EARLY","desc":"Early bird credit","quantity":1,"unit_price":-300.0,"line_total":-300.0},
  {"code":"USAGE","desc":"API tokens","quantity":1,"unit_price":3200.0,"line_total":3200.0}
]
```

emma (finance): note the compute line_total is 0.0 but quantity & unit_price present. looks like proration/zeroing bug. :thinking_face:

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-03-INV-890 generated by billing-run-2026-03-01T02:00Z (job id br-1102).

devon (payments): I can take a look at the billing-run logs. mike, any recent deploy touching line-item proration?

mike (billing-eng): We rolled proration fix last week (deploy br-prorate-v2) which changes how credits are applied across reserved vs on-demand lines. Could be a regression.

sara (ops): FYI support ticket from AcmeCorp: "we were charged compute in two places and invoice shows zero for compute line". They're asking for an adjusted invoice asap.

kate (support): escalating to enterprise ops. Need ETA on root cause and hotfix so I can tell customer. :pray:

mike (billing-eng): I pulled the job logs. Looks like during aggregation, the compute line had an accidental integer cast when applying remaining_credit, resulting in line_total=0.0 when remaining_credit >= computed_charge. Reproducer in staging: 
```
# bad behavior
line_total = max(0, int(calculated_charge) - int(remaining_credit))
# should be
line_total = max(0, calculated_charge - remaining_credit)
```

mike (billing-eng): So credits are being over-applied when credits are fractional cents. This can zero out full compute lines.

devon (payments): That explains the imbalance. We also saw the promo applied twice for this account in the run (promo id EARLYBIRD). There was a duplicate promotion record in the customer profile (two active rows). I'll remove the duplicate and re-run invoice generation for this invoice only.

emma (finance): Perfect. Can you include a corrected PDF and a reconciliation note for Acme? We'll need a credit memo if they were double-charged.

mike (billing-eng): I'll push a hotfix to stop int-casting and add a guard for duplicate promo entries in aggregation. Will tag devops for emergency patch.

sara (ops): If you re-run please patch the job id so we can trace it: br-1102-retry-1. Also add a changelog line so audits are happy.

devon (payments): Removing duplicate promo row now. Scheduling re-run of invoice 2026-03-INV-890 in 10m. I'll post results here.

billing-bot: Re-run started: br-1102-retry-1 at 2026-03-01T02:12Z.

devon (payments): Re-run complete — new invoice generated: 2026-03-INV-890-v2. Compute line correctly shows line_total: 3000.0, promo -300.0, total 2700.0. PDF: https://billing.internal/2026-03-INV-890-v2.pdf

emma (finance): Thanks. Please also create credit memo for overcharge and notify Acme account team.

kate (support): Notifying Acme now and sending the corrected invoice. Closing support ticket once they ack.

mike (billing-eng): Follow-ups: 1) deploy hotfix to prod pipeline to prevent int-cast; 2) one-time migration to dedupe promo rows; 3) add unit test to billing-run job. I'll open PRs now.

emma (finance): Great. Thanks everyone for quick response.

kate (support): :thumbsup:
